rows.title: VALTRIX Passes ISO 9001 Certification
rows.summary: VALTRIX has successfully passed ISO 9001 quality management system certification, covering design, manufacturing and testing of high-purity fluid control components.
rows.summaryEn: VALTRIX has successfully passed ISO 9001 quality management system certification, covering design, manufacturing and testing of high-purity fluid control components.
rows.content:
VALTRIX is pleased to announce that the company has passed the ISO 9001 quality management system certification audit. The certified scope covers the design, machining, assembly, testing and delivery of high-purity fluid control components, including VCR face seal fittings, welded fittings, diaphragm valves, pressure reducers and gas filters.

The certification reflects VALTRIX's commitment to process discipline across the entire value chain — from incoming material traceability (316L stainless steel with mill certificates) through CNC machining, electro-polishing, ultrasonic cleaning, assembly in ISO Class 4/5 cleanrooms, to 100% helium leak testing and final packaging.

"Our quality system is not a document exercise; it is how we run every order," said the VALTRIX quality manager. "Every component that leaves our cleanroom carries full traceability, enabling customers in semiconductor and biopharmaceutical industries to audit our process at any time."

rows.title: Semiconductor CapEx Recovery Drives Demand for High-Purity Fluid Systems
rows.titleEn: Semiconductor CapEx Recovery Drives Demand for High-Purity Fluid Systems
rows.summary: With global fab construction returning to full speed, demand for ultra-high-purity VCR components, diaphragm valves and regulators continues to grow.
rows.summaryEn: With global fab construction returning to full speed, demand for ultra-high-purity VCR components, diaphragm valves and regulators continues to grow.
rows.content:
The global semiconductor industry is entering a new investment cycle. Major foundries and memory manufacturers have announced capacity expansion plans, driving strong demand for UHP fluid handling systems in process tools, gas panels and sub-fab facilities.

As process nodes shrink to 3nm and below, contamination control becomes even more stringent. Every fitting, valve and regulator in the gas delivery path must deliver leak-tightness below 1x10-9 scc/s He, electro-polished surface finishes and particle generation control that meets SEMI standards.

VALTRIX's G-series VCR face seal fittings, diaphragm valves and pressure reducers are designed specifically for this environment. With 316L VIM-VAR material options, EP surface finishing and 100% helium leak testing, VALTRIX products provide the reliability that advanced fabs demand.

rows.title: VALTRIX Launches Ultra-High-Purity VCR Fittings for Semiconductor Fabs
rows.titleEn: VALTRIX Launches Ultra-High-Purity VCR Fittings for Semiconductor Fabs
rows.summary: New G-series VCR face seal fittings deliver metal-sealed, particle-free connections for UHP gas lines.
rows.summaryEn: New G-series VCR face seal fittings deliver metal-sealed, particle-free connections for UHP gas lines.
rows.content:
VALTRIX has expanded its UHP product line with a complete range of G-series VCR face seal fittings. The new series includes male and female nuts, glands, gaskets, reducers, tees, crosses and weld adapters in sizes from 1/4" to 3/4".

VCR face seal connections use a metal gasket compressed between two mating faces, providing a metal-to-metal seal without elastomers. This design eliminates particle generation from O-rings and withstands high temperature bake-out, making it the industry standard for semiconductor gas panels.

All VCR components are manufactured from 316L stainless steel, available in standard or VIM-VAR grades, with optional electro-polished surfaces. Every lot is helium leak tested and packaged in double-bagged cleanroom containers to preserve cleanliness through delivery.

rows.title: VALTRIX Expands Production with New ISO 4 Cleanroom
rows.titleEn: VALTRIX Expands Production with New ISO 4 Cleanroom
rows.summary: A new ISO Class 4 cleanroom and advanced testing lab strengthen VALTRIX's UHP manufacturing capability.
rows.summaryEn: A new ISO Class 4 cleanroom and advanced testing lab strengthen VALTRIX's UHP manufacturing capability.
rows.content:
VALTRIX has completed a major capacity expansion: a new ISO Class 4 cleanroom for final assembly and packaging of ultra-high-purity components, together with an upgraded testing laboratory.

The cleanroom is equipped with HEPA filtration, temperature and humidity control, and strict gowning procedures. Components are cleaned in an ultrasonic bath with ultra-pure water, dried, assembled and packaged entirely within the controlled environment, then double-bagged for shipment.

The new testing lab adds helium mass spectrometer leak testing with sensitivity to 1x10-10 scc/s, plus surface roughness measurement and particle counting, ensuring every shipment meets documented specifications.
